title: Example workflows
description: 24 ready-made multi-agent workflows for typical tasks at work and at home. The preview costs nothing; “Copy to my workflows” creates your own workflow that you can edit freely.
galleryText: Ready-made multi-agent workflows with a test task to try out and adapt. The templates themselves never change.
noMatch: No example matches the search and category.

preview.syntheticNote: The test task contains invented sample data. After copying it is in the start node; replace it there with your own data.
preview.sensitiveNote: This example belongs to {{field}}. The agents produce working aids, not advice: check every result professionally before you use it.
preview.costNote: Previewing and copying are free and call no model. Costs only arise when you run the copy; all it needs is access to the providers of its models.
preview.samplesNote: Small invented files for trying out the file fields. Download them and pick them when you run the workflow.
preview.copyTests: Add the test cases as a test series
preview.copyTestsNote: Creates a test series with these cases. Nothing is run, no schedule is created and no API is published.
preview.orchestratorNote: Does not work on the task itself: it decides at run time which teams work on it and combines their results.
preview.teamsNote: The orchestrator picks the teams that fit the task while it runs. When you copy the example, every team becomes a workflow of its own that you can edit.
preview.teamParameters: Settings the orchestrator can fill in: {{names}}
preview.knowledgeNote: Created in your knowledge base when you copy. The documents are invented; the agents search them and name their sources.
preview.copyTestsConnected: Not possible with a connection: test series run without a person, and MCP tools are not allowed there. Choose offline mode to take over the test cases.

connect.intro: The example works without a connection: the copy then runs in a clearly labelled offline mode with the sample data. With a connection, agents read data through approved read-only tools of an MCP server.
connect.checked: When you copy, Nodestro checks that this server offers every tool approved as read-only. If not, nothing is copied.
connect.noServers: No MCP server is set up yet, so the copy runs in offline mode.
